known_facts: Reuters 2026-11-10 reports Microsoft and trade groups pressed US administration to stop proposed Chinese optical transceiver import ban; lobbying effort had not previously been reported.
The FCC is considering a ban; a 3.2 Tbps threshold is under consideration but not finalized.
